Mystacoleucus chilopterus is a pelagic cyprinid from the middle Mekong, Chao Phraya and Mae Klong basins in Laos and Thailand.
In the Mekong system it may also occur further upriver in Yunnan province, China, while the Khone Falls in Laos appear to represent its downstream limit.
